# Support

OniRoute is an open-source project maintained by volunteers. The community provides support on a best-effort basis.

## How to get help

- **Usage help and design conversation**: use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/AniruddhaDas1/OniRoute_SwarmAgents/discussions) or the `Question` issue template.
- **Focused questions**: file an issue using the `Question` template, including relevant documentation and reproduction steps.
- **Reproducible bugs**: file an issue using the `Bug report` template.
- **Security vulnerabilities**: follow the [Security Policy](https://github.com/AniruddhaDas1/OniRoute_SwarmAgents/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md) — do not publish exploit details in a public issue.

## Limitations

Maintainers cannot guarantee response times. Support is not provided for:

- Modified forks or local builds that deviate from the frozen architecture.
- Unimplemented provider adapters or third-party endpoints not yet covered by an approved ACR.
- Issues that do not use the provided issue templates or that lack a minimal reproduction.

Review the [Quick Start](https://github.com/AniruddhaDas1/OniRoute_SwarmAgents/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md) and [FAQ](https://github.com/AniruddhaDas1/OniRoute_SwarmAgents/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md) before seeking help — many questions are already answered there.
